The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution is an exfoliating toner designed to gently remove dead skin cells, promoting the appearance of a brighter and more even skin tone. This formulation also helps improve skin texture, reducing the appearance of fine lines. How often should I use Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toner? The Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution can be used once daily, ideally in your PM routine. However, if you are new to chemical exfoliants or direct acids, it’s recommended that you start with 2-3 times a week and gradually increase the frequency as your skin builds tolerance. Can I use Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toner with other acids or retinoids? Do not use the Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution with other direct acids (like salicylic acid) or strong retinoids in the same routine, as this can increase the risk of irritation. Instead, alternate use or use one set of formulations in the AM and the other in the PM. Is Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toner suitable for all skin types? We do not recommend using this formulation on sensitive, peeling, or compromised skin. If you have concerns about sensitivity, consider doing a patch test before full application. What precautions should I take when using The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Exfoliating Toner? The Ordinary Glycolic Acid 7% Toning Solution contains an alpha hydroxy acid (AHA) that can increase your skin's sensitivity to sunlight and put you at risk of sunburn. We strongly recommend using sunscreen, wearing protective clothing, or limiting sun exposure while using this formulation. Multi-Active Radiance Serum works to combat environmental stressors, like pollution and smog, which can make skin look dull and prematurely aged. The formulation boosts radiance , while helping to fade visible dark spots an d smooth the look of skin texture , all of which help to reduce the appearance of atmospheric skin aging. Multi-Antioxidant Radiance Serum combines a total of 8 technologies, including vitamin C and ginseng, and achieves a multi-faceted approach to antioxidant protection suited to use both in the day and at night. When used in the day, the serum-textured formulation helps shield against the damaging effects of pollution, while providing barrier strengthening and lasting hydration for enhanced skin resilience. Part of our range of Multi-Active Solutions , the 8 key technologies found in Multi-Antioxidant Radiance Serum are: Ascorbyl Glucoside: A stabilized form of vitamin C, which is converted to its active form inside the skin. Ginseng Extract: A plant extract that helps protect and soothethe  skin’s stress response against environmental aggressors. EGCG: Designed to help shield against environmental irritants, while protecting skin from external stressors that can contribute to signs of aging. Acetyl Tetrapeptide-2 : A protective biomimetic peptide which helps target the appearance of uneven skin tone to promote a more radiant, healthier-looking appearance. Heptapeptide-6: A turmeric peptide that helps protect against environmental aggressors while also targeting common signs of aging. Ergothioneine: An antioxidant found naturally within the skin, that helps provide protection against environmental stressors, which can cause visible skin damage. Tocotrienols: Derived from annatto seeds and a source of Vitamin E, these molecules help protect from the damaging effects of environmental pollution that can contribute to signs of atmospheric skin aging, while soothing signs of skin irritation that can be caused by environmental stressors. Tremella Fuciformis Sporocarp Extract : A polysaccharide (chain of sugar-like molecules) derived from snow fungus, which creates a protective film on the skin’s surface, helping to attract and hold on to water like a moisture magnet.
